situation (example wording): One arrest reported against several incidents (the FBI's Multiple Arrestee Segments Indicator, DE44)
what the app does today: Each arrestee segment counts as an arrest.
proposed behavior: The arrest counts once (P46, P50: the segment the FBI marks as counted); every incident it is attached to is still cleared by arrest (P64). Depends on the canonical arrestee table carrying the indicator (open with nibrs-model).
exact default or choices offered: Arrest counted once; every attached incident cleared.
why: One apprehension is one arrest, whatever the number of incidents it clears.
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-compile.ts, scripts/nibrs-compile-gate.ts.
